{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-fl-e","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"3982efeae916ee5e76576461201518e197c9b002ae3410f13996c552737d059a","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-fl-class-e:lineage:72","source_registry_sha256":"b17b1a3691c9724cc739459037987900e5b1edce40443ad13e42b6eee3e12974","source_liveness_sha256":"0968940df7e2ea0794d4b4ea984515bb41aeba17bada73f538009ca9e9f9cf7a"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Your Vehicle","heading":"C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Your Vehicle","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Your Vehicle

FACT_ID: sec05-R01 | anchor: A01
You must hold a title proving ownership before getting a license plate, non-residents beginning Florida employment or public-school enrollment must register within ten days, and out-of-state vehicles require vehicle identification number verification except new vehicles, mobile homes, trailer-type recreational vehicles, and trailers or semitrailers weighing under two thousand pounds [A01].
Why it matters: group registration; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F01, sec05-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec05-R02 | anchor: A01
Renewals die at the birthday midnight, mobile rigs at year end, fleets at midyear, and all reopen 90 days early [A01].
Why it matters: group renewal; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec05-R03 | anchor: A02
Low beams show 150 and high beams 450, both seen at 1,000, tails at 1,000, brake lamps 300 by day, and plates 50 [A02].
Why it matters: group lamps; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec05-F04 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec05-R04 | anchor: A02
Forward-visible red lights, blue lights, more than two extra lights, sirens, bells, or whistles, smoking or loud mufflers heard past fifty feet, and window or windshield signs, posters, or stickers not required by law are prohibited equipment [A02].
Why it matters: group banned-gear; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec05-R05 | anchor: A03
Screens and headsets distract illegally while airbags only assist belts, never replacing them [A03].
Why it matters: group cabin; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F06 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec05-R06 | anchor: A03
Warning helpers only alert on spots, gaps, drift, and cross traffic, while acting helpers brake and steer back [A03].
Why it matters: group adas; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec05-F07, sec05-F08 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec05-R07 | anchor: A04
Rear automatic braking can stop a reversing vehicle. Adaptive cruise changes speed to maintain a selected gap. Lane centering makes continuous steering adjustments, while lane keeping may steer, brake or accelerate individual wheels, or combine these actions, to guide the vehicle back into its lane [A04].
Why it matters: group assist; difficulty medium; prereq sec05-R06; confusables sec05-F09 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec05-R08 | anchor: A04
Crash callers phone rescuers, auto beams swap for traffic, and cameras never replace mirrors and looks [A04].
Why it matters: group assist; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F10 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec05-R09 | anchor: A04
Anti-lock stops stomp, hold, and steer, and any pumping or lifting kills the assist [A04].
Why it matters: group abs; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F11 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec05-R10 | anchor: A05
Plain brakes pump sliding stops, bumpers step with weight, and emission tampering is flatly illegal [A05].
Why it matters: group brakes-body; difficulty medium; prereq sec05-R09; confusables sec05-F12 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec05-R11 | anchor: A05
Light trailers reflector-pair while heavy ones lamp their corners and rears [A05].
Why it matters: group trailer-lamps; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F13 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec05-R12 | anchor: A06
Towed brakes answer the driver and self-stop when parted, with stop lamps doubled except pre-1972 singles [A06].
Why it matters: group trailer-brakes; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F14 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec05-R13 | anchor: A06
A drawbar or towing connection must be strong enough for all towed weight, measure at most fifteen feet unless towing poles, pipes, machinery, or other objects not easily dismounted, and carry a white flag at least twelve inches square when using chain, rope, or cable; loads that could fall or blow require a close-fitting cover, and log or pulpwood trucks require lock chains [A06].
Why it matters: group towing; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F15, sec05-F16 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec05-R14 | anchor: A06
Loads extending past the sides and four feet or more past the rear need eighteen-inch-square red flags by day, and from sunset to sunrise or in rain, smoke, or fog require two rear red lamps visible five hundred feet, two rear red reflectors visible one hundred to six hundred feet, and or one red lamp on each side visible five hundred feet; log, pulpwood, pole, or post loads overhanging past four feet always need an operating amber strobe visible from behind and both sides [A06].
Why it matters: group overhang; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec05-F17 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec05-R15 | anchor: A06
Car loads hold the left fender line and clear the right by six inches at most [A06].
Why it matters: group overhang; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F18 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0050]
